summary: Funk: 90–115 BPM 16th-note grooves on the one, dorian vamps, slap bass, clav and brass stabs
body: Drums: busy 16th hats, ghost notes on the snare, the kick locking with the bass; everything lands hard on the one.
Harmony: one- or two-chord vamps (i7–IV7 dorian, dominant 9ths); stabs and riffs more than progressions.
Bass: syncopated 16ths, octaves, slap; it is a lead instrument.
Clav or guitar comping in 16ths; short brass stabs.

Apply: pattern/gmd-funk-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/dorian-i-IV on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 90–115 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
